The '''BB-22 Salvage Droid''' was a model of [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]]-shaped [[Salvage droid/Legends|salvage droid]] that saw use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A number of BB-22 droids worked with [[S7-H7 Slicing Droid]]s and [[JT-65 Salvage Droid]]s in the [[Barasin Refuse Yards]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
BB-22 Salvage Droids appear as enemies in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found in the Barasin Refuse Yards in the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
